name: Birds of Tokyo - Designed
caption:
Okay, so this is one of those very simple, yet hits-you-hard songs.. “Human Design” was one of my most played albums of 2020..

Anyways, this is one of the prime examples of why you should not play drunk, but in any case, it was quite fun to do. 

Yes, it is just an unplugged Tele, did not have my hands on an acoustic at that time. 

Recorded in Mar ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 18 | Lamn of God - Laid to Rest
name: Lamn of God - Laid to Rest
caption:
Okay, 

So this is a cover of a song which I have been playing for years and years and years.. it reminds me of all the battle of bands that I have been to, and the sheer feel and power of this live is quite indescribable.. yes, I love my fair share of metal. 

Recorded in Apr ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 19 | Josh Radnor - Come Close To Me
name: Josh Radnor - Come Close To Me
caption:
Imo, there is something really.. pure about this.. the simplicity of this, combined with the fact that there’s no ulterior motive than just making and sharing music (gaining subscribers, endorsements, “influencing”, changing your style to appeal to a broader audience, etc) all this, just makes this feel like a never-ending competition, and more often than not, it sucks out the simple and pure joy of music. 

To me, this piece by Josh Radnor (yes, Ted from HIMYM) exemplifies all this, and I find myself coming back to this time and again

name: Blackstratblues - Tiny Bit of Sky (Verse)

Also, this comes at a time (like right now) where a lot of things are done for me before a big move, snd I can let my “hair down”

- Autumn Leaves (~Aug ‘20)

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 28 | Solos from Hotel California
name: Solos from Hotel California
caption:
So, what to say about this.. classic solos (performed on electric cause the acoustic one got blocked on this platform) 

But anyways, this was during the month I was learning how to play Hotel Cali, and I am quite pleased with the end result (you can get a link to the drive video from my YouTube page)

This particular one was played over a looped track in Bangalore. 

This was recorded ~May ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 29 | Slidey Stuff
name: Slidey Stuff
caption:
Okay, 

Honestly, I’d got a slide as a birthday present in like 2012, when I was quite influenced by Derek Trucks.. only after like 8 years am I putting it to proper use. It’s quite challenging, and a lot of it is based on feel.. was quite nice to figure out “Mr. Blue”’s horns part on it. 

So, this is an amalgamation of 2 videos:

1. Mr. Blue slide practise: (recorded ~June ‘21)

This was when I got the feel to do the best Bojack song, and I’m really pleased with how the end product turned out, you can watch it on my YouTube 

2. Beggars n hangers on: (recorded ~Feb ‘20)

Tbh, if it wasn’t clear, I was quite drunk there and it was mighty fun to make those sounds via the bottle hehe.

caption:

But yeah, Ima need to do something with this idea later on for sure

caption:

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 33 | Guns N' Roses - Locomotive (Verse/Main Riff)
name: Guns N' Roses - Locomotive (Verse/Main Riff)
caption:
Hey,

This, for me was the intro to funk metal, and damn, it’s one of GNR’s really “out there songs”, which I am have been jamming to since like 2010 (I vividly recall buying the UYI II CD), and after many, many years, I am (kinda) able to play the main riff :P, so here’s one of my jam sessions.

This was recorded ~ Feb ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 34 | Jimi Hendrix/John Mayer - Bold as Love
name: Jimi Hendrix/John Mayer - Bold as Love
caption:
Okay, so this is probably where the whole “Hendrix/Mayer” style of playing actually materialised for me.. I’d taken this course by Jamie Harrison, and damn if it wasn’t one of the best things I did for my playing. It literally upped my guitar game xD (got like half of it to go through even now tho lol)

Anyway, the whole thing is up on YouTube, with amazing vocals added on it as well (not mine!) and this was a practise session for the same. 

This was recorded ~Aug ‘20

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 35 | Improv - Something Funky
name: Improv - Something Funky
caption:
Okay, so first off, I really don’t recall why I am wearing that helmet xD and I also can’t recall if alcohol was involved or not lol 

Anyway, this is just something that came up when I was messing with the envelope filter on the amp. That’s always fun to do!

This was recorded ~May ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 36 | Maroon 5 - Memories
name: Maroon 5 - Memories

This was recorded ~ Aug ‘21

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 37 | Smashing Pumpkins - Mayonaise
name: Smashing Pumpkins - Mayonaise
caption:
So, 

Honestly, this doesn’t do the song much justice, but really, you do have to start somewhere. I can’t really express how much this means to me (easily in the top 5 for me).. anyways, this is a pretty decent practise clip. Will def record this properly someday (hopefully within this decade lol)

name: John Mayer - In your Atmosphere
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 49 | John Mayer - In your Atmosphere

(This was recorded ~Apr ‘22)

title: UGG Chronicles Ep.50 | Guns N’ Roses - November Rain Piano Cover
name: Guns N’ Roses - November Rain Piano Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep.50 | Guns N’ Roses - November Rain Piano Cover

So, I know this is not much of upping my “Guitar” game, but playing the piano is something I took over the summer, and I’ve been really enjoying it. 

50th episode is a nice milestone, and this song for me is also a nice personal milestone. 

Perhaps this is not the place to vent, but the landscape of me recording and sharing stuff like this has changed. This is the first full-length thing I have not put up in YouTube, rather here. Hope this is here to stay.

name: “Shattered” End Part Guitar Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 53 | “Shattered” End Part Guitar Cover

I got introduced to this song ~2013 when everything that I’d known till then started shaking up. 10 years later, and this still reminds me of that time. Closest I felt like this was listening to “Iris”, but that’s something for another day. 

This was recorded ~May ‘22

name: Guns N’ Roses - Mr Brownstone Guitar Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 54 | Guns N’ Roses - Mr Brownstone Guitar Cover

So, I wanted to start this year off with something like this. GN’R is and always will be my “comfort” band. It reminds me of circa 2010 and simpler times, which I often look back to. This particular song always gets me grooving. I know I need the Les Paul for this, but I work with what I got xD

UGG Chronicles Ep. 55 | Sum 41 - So Long Goodbye

UGG Chronicles Ep. 60 | KALEO - Broken Bones Guitar Cover

PC: @induchabada

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 80 | Ethereal/Ambient Idea
name: Ethereal/Ambient Idea
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 80 | Ethereal/Ambient Idea

This was heavily inspired by Ariel Posen. Stumbled upon his stuff ~2021, and loved the vibe. This is one of those instances where having a good rig reeeealy helps.

And on a side note, I was just thinking how times have changed in terms of me recording music stuff and sharing them on the internet. A decade (and even more really) ago, when I was putting stuff up on YouTube, I could only think of being able to do it on a weekly basis (it was maybe 5-6 videos a year), with this kind of engagement and reach. If the 13-year old me were to get to know about this (and the gear), he’d be mighty pleased. Guess we all need to just sometimes take a moment to turn back,  take in and be grateful in how far we’ve come.

name: Plain White T’s - Hey There Delilah Acoustic Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 126 | Plain White T’s - Hey There Delilah Acoustic Cover

This song immediately transports me to 7th/8th standard when a friend introduced me to this song. It seems like forever ago, and the simplicity of those times just seems unreal now.. but I know a 12/13 year old would be chuffed to know the gear I have now! 
You know, we might —in part, and without even realizing it— be living the life we dreamt of all those years ago.. It’s important to take a moment to reflect and be grateful for it.

This was recorded ~Oct ’23

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 127 | Anuv Jain - Baarishein Acoustic Cover
name: Anuv Jain - Baarishein Acoustic Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 127 | Anuv Jain - Baarishein Acoustic Cover

Okay, so I admit I got to know about this cause it came up on my insta, and this was released smash dab in the middle of my engineering. (I was way too caught up with TLT to even notice other artists tho lol). But I’m glad I found this. Musically, it’s pretty simple (downright boring, I thought the first time I heard it), but it’s grown on me, and I just wanted the lyrics to shine here.

And on a playing side note, playing simple stuff can really be quite humbling. You really have to concentrate at times, and you get to know where you lack musically, or in technique.

This was recorded ~Nov ’23

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 128 | Taylor Swift - Style, Bass Cover
name: Taylor Swift - Style, Bass Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 128 | Taylor Swift - Style, Bass Cover

Okay, so this is one of those pop songs that are really fun (and easy) to play on the bass. I jam out to Taylor Swift time and again, and sometimes the fun sing-along songs are what you need after an eventful day!
(Oh yeah, and I am growing out me beard. Not entirely sure why, but I’ma see how long I can keep it for)

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 129 | Blues Jam Solo
name: Blues Jam Solo
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 129 | Blues Jam Solo

So, for the past few months, I have been going to open mic/blues jams hosted by the Blues Society of Central PA. It really gave me confidence to improv on stage (and build confidence playing ofc). This clip is from 13th Oct, and has to be one of my best solos that came out in a while!
PC: @davidandrewshultz, thanks for this again!

UGG Chronicles Ep. 130 | The Rolling Stones - Beast of Burden Guitar Jam Along

In terms of the Christmas hat, why not lol.

June of ’22 was quite the summer for me, nothing like what was to come the following year, but knowing that, it’s nice to look back at these clips.

UGG Chronicles Ep. 142 | Linkin Park - Papercut Bass Cover

name: Taylor Swift - Champagne Problems Guitar Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 143 | Taylor Swift - Champagne Problems Guitar Cover

There was just something about “Folklore” and “Evermore” that just does it for me. I remember listening to them back to back during the lockdowns. It seems like a completely different time. 

And as far as this song goes, I’d wanted to do a piano cover (since it’s just like 4 chords), but I don’t have a piano at my disposal anymore sadly. I’d been a bit out of practice, so this was a good song to get back in the groove.

Took a few tries to get into the groove, but it was worth it.

caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 149 | Taylor Swift - The Way I Loved You Bass Cover

title: UGG Chronicles Ep. 150 | The Goo Goo Dolls - Iris, Acoustic Cover
name: The Goo Goo Dolls - Iris, Acoustic Cover
caption:
UGG Chronicles Ep. 150 | The Goo Goo Dolls - Iris, Acoustic Cover

Okay, so this one’s special.
I remember hearing this song for the first time on top of a rock, from a friend’s phone on a school trip back in 2012. It hit me like a ton of bricks, and it’s only a few other songs that have had that much of an impact on me. I’ve been wanting to cover it since the YouTube days, and I reckon I am finally at that point in my life where I’d want to do it. 

Also, this is the 100th episode of when I restarted UGG a year and a few months back. Things have changed oh-so-much, and I am supremely grateful for where I am right now. 

This was recorded ~Mar ’24
